contexts.text: Behold, I pray my lords () = interior acknowledgement and confession of the Lord's Divine Human and Holy Proceeding...
(Abraham) said, Behold I () = thought and reflection...
(Esau) said to (his father), Behold me (), which is the answer, = presence.
Behold, I am with thee () = the Divine.
Behold, two men, Hebrews, wrangling () = apperception that within the Church they were fighting each other. Behold, or seeing = apperception.
Behold the Man () = behold the Divine Truth, such as it is in the Church at this day.
After He had been scourged, etc., He said, Behold the Man... because by the Man is signified the Church...
